Players Committee card image of [[Slip Sliding Away (V)]] (Virtual Set 12), Set 18 errata of April 2022 (card marked “E1”), printing: “If you have deployed a site (except Imperial Square) with exactly two [Dark Side] (and no other locations), deploy a related (or mobile) battleground site and up to three Effects that deploy for free and are always immune to Alter. Place Interrupt in Lost Pile.” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/2640d50/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual12-Dark/hires/slipslidingaway.png Images-HT/starwars/Virtual12-Dark/hires/slipslidingaway.png] as of commit 2640d50 “Set 18 and errata” (20 April 2022).
